generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government/Government of India/Union Territory

The Tenders/ Bids are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-3:The contractor shall attach all the requisite documents as required in the standard bid document. The Bidders shall abide as per the detailed instructions and conditions contained in standard bid document KW-3

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than One times the annual payments from this contract as per KW-3

Satisfactorily completed (at least 50% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar nature work (building) is to be completed of value not less than Rs. 28.39 lakhs -Usually not less than 50% estimated value of contract

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should ossess valid Electrical License for executing building ectrification works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
The Payment for the work will be made based on availability of funds and according to Queue system
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditors reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

The Bidder required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be esponsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% 2 of 31 eprocurement of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt, orders as may be modified from time to time

The tenderer shall scan original Workdone ertificates/Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake/Taken back
The contractors shall collect necessary samples as required & all relevant requisite tests to be got done by the egistered institution or firms with consultants with the Third Party
The Department is not responsible for any delay caused in accessing the e-procurement portal
Tender validity for valid bid is 90 days

Manual Means -
Earth work   excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including  setting  out,   shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,  removal of stumps and other deleterious matter,   excavated surface leveled and sides neatly  dressed  disposing  off  the  excavated  stuff  or  sorting  &    stacking  the selected  stuff for reuse in a radius of  50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 1.5 m

Manual Means -
Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating Each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.

Filling approved earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating Each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto

Buildings
